description: Defines a Mongoose model for LLM cost records, including schema, indexes, and collection configuration, used for tracking and analytics of LLM usage costs.

classes.name: CostBreakdownSchema
classes.description: Schema for flexible cost component key-value pairs, allowing varied cost record structures.

classes.name: LLMCostsSchema
classes.description: Schema for LLM cost records with fields like task_id, session_id, tenant_id, project_id, user_id, model, provider, service_type, operation, total_cost, currency, breakdown, metadata, timestamp, created_at, updated_at, including indexes for efficient querying.

methods.name: pre('findOneAndUpdate')
methods.description: Middleware to automatically update 'updated_at' timestamp before record update.
